text:
aisha: Following up after the vendor-chain outage postmortem. The pattern looks like: cloud region packet loss -> registry read spikes -> auth token refresh storms. We need tight owners, short-term mitigations, and a longer term drill cadence. I'll capture AIs here.

ops-bot: Postmortem summary: https://redwood.internal/pm/vendor-chain-2026-03-22. Related runbooks: /runbooks/cloud-region-failover, /runbooks/model-registry-emergency, /runbooks/oidc-degradation.

tom: I'll pick up the cloud-side mitigations. Short-term: stricter health checks, reduce fail-open windows, and a canary sweep for cross-AZ traffic. Long-term: add automated runbook-triggered reroute for affected prefixes. ETA short-term: 2026-03-30; ETA long-term: 2026-04-20.

rita: I'll handle model-registry resilience. Proposals: (1) async model manifest replication to a regional blob store, (2) client-side backoff + per-host concurrency caps, (3) stale-manifest mode for serving when registry unavailable > 45s. ETA for 1+2: 2026-04-08, ETA for 3: 2026-04-04. Note: registry got hammered during auth floods last year too.

samir: On auth, root cause was parallel refresh attempts per instance. Short-term hotfix: singleton refresh token mutex per process + exponential jittered backoff. I can ship hotfix in 24-48h if approved. Longer: token-refresh as shared service w/ signed assertions. Hotfix ETA: 2026-03-26, long-term ETA: 2026-04-25.

nina: I'll coordinate customer-facing comms and priority tagging for Dedicated tenants. Please flag any items that require a roadmap shift. Also request we add SLA impact labels to the AI tickets.

tom: Ops note: prefer application-layer routing for reroute (less DNS TTL pain). We'll implement a rollback-safe switch and monitor session continuity metrics.

aisha: Action items I'll create now; owners please confirm or reassign within 12h.

- AI-622: Cloud health-check tightening + canary cross-AZ sweep (owner: tom) ETA: 2026-03-30
- AI-623: Registry async manifest replication + concurrency caps (owner: rita) ETA: 2026-04-08
- AI-624: Stale-manifest serving mode + verification harness (owner: rita) ETA: 2026-04-04
- AI-625: Hotfix: per-process token-refresh mutex + jitter (owner: samir) ETA: 2026-03-26
- AI-626: Token-refresh service design doc + IAM list (owner: samir) ETA: 2026-04-25
- AI-627: Runbook failover drill schedule + test checklist (owner: tom) ETA: 2026-04-02

ops-bot: Tickets created: AI-622, AI-623, AI-624, AI-625, AI-626, AI-627. Linked to PM-2026-03-22.

samir: Hotfix snippet I'll push to PR with test plan:```bash
# guard to avoid parallel refreshes
if ! pidof token_refresh || [ -z "$TOKEN_REFRESH_LOCK" ]; then
  export TOKEN_REFRESH_LOCK=1
  python -m redwood.auth.refresh
  unset TOKEN_REFRESH_LOCK
fi
```

rita: For stale-manifest mode, I'll add an automated verification: diff live manifest vs cached manifest on canary traffic and fail if model checksum mismatch > 0.1%. That will be in AI-624.

aisha: Good — please also add rollback criteria: e.g., increase in model mismatch rate, >0.5% user-facing errors, or error budget burn above threshold.

nina: I'll prepare a short customer impact note template that PMs can send if any AI misses ETA. Will tag Dedicated customers.

tom: Ops will schedule monthly vendor-dependency drills and a quarterly deep-dive on registry auth coupling. I'll create a recurring calendar and link to AI-627.

samir: If no objections, I'll greenlight the hotfix tonight. It contains only mutex + jitter and a short test plan.

rita: No objections from me. Shipping the client circuit breaker + replication will reduce blast radius anyway.

aisha: Confirmed. Samir, ship hotfix and post the canary metrics to AI-625. Rita and Tom, please add test steps to your PRs (including rollback plan). Everyone: tag relevant observability dashboards in the ticket.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up review scheduled 2026-04-06 09:00 PT. Participants: aisha, tom, rita, samir, nina.

aisha: Closing note: we'll track recurrence patterns monthly and consider making the cross-vendor drill mandatory for on-call. If any ETA slips, update ticket and notify nina. Thanks.
